parsed.note_claim: Ceuta was acquired by Portugal in 1415 and ceded to Spain in 1668, long before Morocco's independence in 1956.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In 1415, Marinid Ceuta was conquered and annexed by the Kingdom of Portugal . In 1580, it was annexed by the Hispanic Monarchy , and the city chose to remain under Spanish authority after 1640.
